title: Fighting COVID-19 Misinformation on Social Media: Experimental Evidence for a Scalable Accuracy-Nudge Intervention
overview: Pennycook et al. (2020), Psychological Science 31(7): two online survey experiments on COVID-19 headlines (accuracy vs. sharing; accuracy nudge) and a post hoc item-level analysis.

readiness.note: All four arms can be run. The Study 2 pretest headlines, question and framing are transcribed from sources/study2_materials (txt and docx). Open: how one of the four pretest headlines was assigned (iss_s2_pretest_assign), the original pictures/ledes, and the original instructions.
